description: Configure Amazon SES email sending for Sentlu with three DKIM CNAME records and a dedicated bounce subdomain for return-path MX and SPF. Existing website records, inbound mailbox MX records and DMARC policy are not part of this template.
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2, dkim3: the three Easy DKIM selectors returned by Amazon SES for the sending identity; region: the AWS SES region, for example eu-central-1. Use the standard host parameter for a sending subdomain, or omit host for the zone apex.
